findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_free_api_key · Private data: get_free_api_key, get_base_wallet_intel, buy_call_credits_bundle, buy_enterprise_bundle, check_token_safety, get_whale_flow · Public sink: get_free_api_key, get_base_gas_oracle.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_free_api_key · Private data: get_free_api_key, get_base_wallet_intel, buy_call_credits_bundle, buy_enterprise_bundle, check_token_safety, get_whale_flow · Public sink: get_free_api_key, get_base_gas_oracle

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
